packages.name: packaging
packages.source:
from packaging.version import Version
versions = sorted([Version('2'), Version('1.0rc1'), Version('1.0')])
print([str(value) for value in versions])
print(Version('1!2.0.post3+linux.1').epoch)

packages.name: pyparsing
packages.source:
from pyparsing import Word, nums, delimited_list
integer = Word(nums).set_parse_action(lambda tokens: int(tokens[0]))
print(delimited_list(integer).parse_string('2, 3, 5, 7').as_list())

@attrs.define
class Point:

    y: int = 2

print(attrs.asdict(p))
